title: Bookkeeper
mission: Keep Northlight's books accurate and current so the owners can see cash, jobs and tax obligations every month.
outcomes_90_days: Reconcile every bank and card account each month within a week of the statement date
Move vendor bill entry and the weekly payment run off the owners' Sunday nights
Send customer invoices on the day a job closes and chase late payers on a schedule
Deliver a clean profit and loss and balance sheet to the owners by a fixed day each month
Prepare sales tax and payroll records so quarterly filings need no scramble

criteria.name: Bookkeeping fundamentals
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Codes and posts transactions correctly, understands the chart of accounts and can explain why an entry goes where it does.
evidence_needed: Daily or weekly entry work on a real set of books
Journal entries, accruals or a chart of accounts they set up or cleaned
levels: 4 did it and taught or improved it
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows hands on bookkeeping such as coding, posting and journal entries, with real examples

criteria.name: Bank reconciliation
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Reconciles bank and card accounts to the statement, finds the cause of differences and clears old items.
evidence_needed: Monthly reconciliations done and how many accounts
How they chase a difference to its cause
levels: 4 did it and taught or improved it
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows the person reconciling accounts to statements and resolving differences, with real examples

criteria.name: Payables and receivables
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Enters and pays vendor bills on time, invoices customers promptly and follows up late payments in a routine.
evidence_needed: Weekly payment runs or invoice volumes
An aging report or collections routine
levels: 4 did it and taught or improved it
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows managing vendor bills and customer invoices, including late payment follow up

criteria.name: Accounting software
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Comfortable in an off the shelf accounting package and a spreadsheet, using bank feeds and reports.
evidence_needed: Reports or rules they set up
levels: 4 did it and taught or improved it
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows regular, confident use of accounting software and spreadsheets

criteria.name: Payroll and sales tax
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Has prepared payroll records and sales tax figures that went to a filing without surprises.
evidence_needed: Payroll run or preparation for a small team
Sales tax or similar filings prepared
levels: 4 did it and taught or improved it
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows preparing payroll or sales tax records with real examples

criteria.name: Month end close
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Follows a checklist to close each month and delivers a profit and loss and balance sheet on a fixed day.
evidence_needed: Statements delivered and by which day
levels: 4 did it and taught or improved it
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows a repeatable month end close that produced financial statements

criteria.name: Accuracy and controls
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Checks their own work, notices errors and duplicates, and sets simple approval steps for payments.
evidence_needed: A check or approval step they added
levels: 4 did it and taught or improved it
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows careful checking, catching errors and simple controls over payments

gates.question: Can the person legally work in the country of the role?

deal_breakers.description: The person states they knowingly altered or hid financial records.
deal_breakers.job_related_reason: The job is to keep honest books. A person who admits falsifying records cannot be trusted with the bank accounts.

work_sample.title: Find the difference
work_sample.brief: You get a one month bank statement and a ledger export for the same account. They differ by a small amount. List the differences you find, say what you think caused each one and what you would ask the owner.
work_sample.how_to_score: Score for finding the causes, clear notes and sensible questions. Do not score speed alone or the software used.

interview_questions.question: The bank balance and the books differ by a small amount at month end. Walk me through what you do.
good_answer_signs: Checks date range and opening balance first
Looks for timing items, duplicates and transposed digits

interview_questions.question: A customer is 45 days late. What happens next in your routine?
good_answer_signs: Escalates to the owner with a clear summary

interview_questions.question: Tell me about a mistake you found in the books. How did you find it and what changed afterwards?
good_answer_signs: A real example with the cause
A change that stops it happening again

interview_questions.question: The owner buys a ladder for the crews with the business card. How do you record it and what do you ask?
good_answer_signs: Asks about cost and expected use
Explains asset versus expense in plain words

red_flags: Lists software with no description of weekly work
Has never reconciled an account without someone checking it
Treats a plug figure as an acceptable fix
sourcing_channels: Local job boards the owner uses
Freelance bookkeepers who want steady part time work
pay_research_hint: Search local job boards for bookkeeper roles in your city and note the ranges shown. Ask your accountant what they pay or charge for similar work.
automation_note: Bank feeds, receipt capture and rules can enter and match most routine items. A person still reviews the reconciliation, handles odd items and answers the owners' questions.
